rationales.objective_measurability: The success criteria are measurable (e.g., 'all targeted invalid values are replaced'), though the specific invalid values in scope require researcher definition[cite: 21].
rationales.objective_assessment_alignment: The integrated summative task flawlessly demands both code execution and explicit justification referencing data-quality criteria[cite: 21].
rationales.evidence_validity: An integrated performance task yielding executable Python and written rationale is a highly valid measure of this capability[cite: 21].
rationales.cognitive_alignment: The objectives target 'apply' and 'evaluate', which align perfectly with the coding and justification tasks[cite: 21].
rationales.prerequisite_quality: Correctly isolates Python syntax and tabular data concepts as absolute entry gates, avoiding the trap of trying to teach them within the 60-minute window[cite: 21].
rationales.course_sequence_coherence: Module 1 (Transformation) naturally feeds into Module 2 (Justification), respecting the dependency that a transformation must exist before it can be justified[cite: 21].
rationales.instruction_assessment_alignment: Worked examples and guided practice directly scaffold the integrated performance task[cite: 21].
rationales.scope_balance: The instructional design perfectly matches the procedural application (transforming data) and the conceptual evaluation (justifying trade-offs) required by the summative assessments without introducing extraneous topics.
rationales.workload_time_realism: There is meaningful time pressure. Expecting learners to complete hands-on coding practice, justification scenarios, and an integrated summative coding and writing assessment within a strict 60-minute window is highly ambitious and may require reducing the practice scope.
rationales.domain_appropriateness: The design appropriately uses hands-on coding execution and applied data transformation with explicit justification of trade-offs, which accurately reflects standard data engineering and Python processing practices.

special_question.rationale: The progression from applying a procedural transformation to evaluating and justifying the choices using executable Python code forms an excellent, highly authentic pedagogical sequence for data processing.
